name: Build-out & Shop Basics
why: Lumber, paint and storage for our work parties as we reorganize the space, plus the safety gear and supplies every class uses up.

name: Woodshop
why: A SawStop that stops on contact with skin, real dust collection, and the tools members keep asking for.

name: Laser
why: Filtered extraction so the laser can run all day without smoke in the room.

name: 3D Printing
why: Beginner-friendly Bambu printers to replace machines new members find hard to learn.

name: Print & Press
why: A desktop UV printer for full-color prints on wood, acrylic, metal and tumblers.

name: Studio & Commons
why: A podcast and video corner, plus member storage, the most requested improvement in our survey.

name: Electronics Bench
why: A soldering and electronics station for LED signs, badges and kits.

name: Textiles
why: Cutting and sewing basics for classes like aprons, stockings and bowl cozies.
